name: 안개빵 해면
description: 갓 찐 빵처럼 폭신한 연보라 해면. 안개달의 얕은 바닥에 붙어 작은 구멍으로 물을 천천히 들이마신다.
subject: a small lavender and cream bread-roll-shaped SEA SPONGE, rounded pillowy lobes, tiny natural water pores, no anthropomorphic face or added eyes, attached to a tiny pale stone, side view with slightly taller lobe on right
motion: remain anchored; only pores subtly dilate and soft outer fringe gently responds to current; do not translate the sponge or invent eyes

name: 속삭임 실고기
description: 실처럼 가는 은보라 몸과 조그만 귀 모양 지느러미를 가진 실고기. 수초 사이를 지나며 들리지 않는 바다의 이야기를 전한다.
subject: a slender silvery-lavender PIPEFISH with a clear long tubular snout, delicate cream segmented body, tiny ear-shaped pectoral fins, one gentle glossy eye; head to RIGHT and thin tail trailing LEFT
motion: restrained fine dorsal-fin ripples, tiny fin-tip flutter and gentle tail-end wave; long tubular head and front body stay fixed; never wag a fin like an arm

name: 꿈실타래 갯지렁이
description: 은빛 실타래처럼 부드럽게 굽은 작은 갯지렁이. 안개달의 모래 위를 기어가며 몸 가장자리의 가는 털을 물살에 맡긴다.
subject: a friendly little silver-lilac segmented BRISTLE WORM, flowing loosely S-curved horizontal body, delicate short bristles, small rounded head at RIGHT, narrower tail LEFT; do not add a human face or giant eyes
motion: small coordinated bristle strokes and subtle segment undulation through four crawl phases, head remains registered; avoid whole-body bouncing or knotting

name: 안개수염 메기
description: 은빛 수염을 길게 늘어뜨린 회보라색 메기. 안개달의 고요한 물밑을 누비면 수염 끝이 꿈결처럼 뒤따라 흔들린다.
subject: a round friendly gray-lavender CATFISH with creamy belly, broad short snout and long delicate silvery whiskers, small calm paired fins, glossy eyes, subtle mist-colored spots; head RIGHT tail LEFT
motion: long whiskers stream and gently curl in the current, small tail beat and thin rear-fin edges flex, paired front fins remain calm and still

name: 달그림자 가자미
description: 달그림자처럼 납작한 몸에 은빛 테두리를 두른 가자미. 안개달의 모래 가까이에서 가장자리 지느러미를 잔물결처럼 움직인다.
subject: a cute flattened oval FLOUNDER, slate-lavender upper body, ivory-silver ruffled rim and subtle crescent shadow marking, anatomically readable two small eyes on upper visible side and mouth at RIGHT, tail at LEFT, low side-three-quarter view
motion: small traveling wave along entire thin dorsal/anal perimeter, little tail flex; central flat body and eyes absolutely steady, no arm-like fin gestures

name: 루네아의 기사
description: 초승달 뿔과 진주빛 비늘 갑옷을 두른 해마 기사. 루네아의 작은 문장을 품고 안개달의 조용한 항로를 지킨다.
subject: an elegant magical SEAHORSE KNIGHT, pearl-silver scale armor integrated into natural seahorse body, one small crescent horn, pale-lavender translucent dorsal fin, a tiny crescent emblem, curled tail and gentle vigilant violet eye, delicate flowing gill ribbons, no humanoid limbs or held weapons; head/snouted face RIGHT, curled tail trailing LEFT
motion: small natural dorsal membrane waves, gill ribbons and slender tail tip softly flow in current; armored head/chest and crescent horn stay rigid; no exaggerated rocking

name: 루네아의 기록관
description: 달의 무늬가 새겨진 나선 껍데기에 바다의 꿈을 간직한 노틸러스. 루네아를 위해 긴 촉수로 잊힌 물결의 기억을 더듬는다.
subject: a magical NAUTILUS archivist, pearlescent silver-lavender spiral shell with delicate crescent and tidal-ring engravings like ancient records, soft violet living body and long fine translucent tentacles emerging toward SCREEN RIGHT, a single gentle visible eye, subtle gold crescent emblem; no books, words or human arms
motion: fine tentacles stream and flex through gentle current phases and small mantle-edge motion, solid spiral shell stays absolutely registered and unchanged; do not spin or resize shell

name: 안개달의 여신 루네아
description: 은빛 머리카락과 달무리 베일을 물살에 펼치는 인어 여신. 안개달의 잠든 생물들을 보살피며 고요한 바다에 부드러운 빛을 남긴다.
subject: an adult MERMAID goddess Lunea, serene kind face in right-facing profile, silver-white long flowing hair streaming LEFT, pearl crescent diadem, modest fully covered elegant ivory bodice and translucent lavender moon-veil flowing over shoulders, iridescent silver-lilac mermaid tail with delicate veil-like flukes, hands relaxed close to torso, dignified graceful aquarium fantasy guardian, no legs, no weapons, no sexualized pose; full head to RIGHT and tail flowing LEFT, horizontal gentle swimming profile
motion: hair, veil, long sheer fabric edges and flexible tail-fluke membranes drift in coordinated current, relaxed hands and face/torso stay steady; no arm waving or whole-body bobbing
